items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: Listen in the interview that Marsha Gilmore had with you recently

ctx.x: (Spot and Life?) in Porgie and Bess. (LAUGHTER). Listen in the interview that Marsha Gilmore had with you recently she said QUOTE He disappears for years at a time hibernating as if to meditate like a prophet reemerging as after a revelation, like King Lear.'
Well let's leave the tragic King Lear out of this for a moment. But how do you react to this business of her saying that you disappear for years at a time? Is there some validity to that or?
